item.text: The repository is tiny. The current resolver orders `file -> CLI -> env`, which contradicts the documented precedence and the existing test name that says CLI should win over env.

item.aggregated_output: Precedence: defaults < file settings < environment settings < CLI settings.

item.text: I’ve got enough context to make the scoped fix: reorder the merge so environment beats file settings and CLI beats both. I’ll also add focused coverage for the full chain so this does not regress.
The resolver now follows the README’s documented order. I added one full precedence regression test rather than broad test churn.
